analogue: Particle-phase ester formation involving isoprene-derived 2-methylglyceric acid units following methacrolein oxidation at high NOx.
citation: Chemical Composition of Secondary Organic Aerosol Formed from the Photooxidation of Isoprene
evidence: Chamber SOA product analysis linked 2-methylglyceric acid monomer units to ester-linked higher oligomers in the high-NOx pathway.
difference: This supports accretion of particular particle constituents, not conversion of all particle organics at one quadratic rate. Humidity, precursor branching, and the negligible suspended mass in Manchester's isoprene-only controls restrict transfer.
